Bernalillo County, New Mexico property tax involves the county assessment office and the county treasurer.

Who to contact in Bernalillo County

  • Bernalillo County Treasurer
  • Bernalillo County Assessor handles assessment and appeals.

What we confirmed on official pages

  • Bills available online and mailed no later than Nov 1; first half due Nov 10, late fees begin Dec 10; second half due Apr 10, late fees begin May 10
  • Late fees: interest 1% of unpaid tax per month; penalty 1% per month, max 5%, minimum $5
  • Pay in person (415 Silver Ave SW, 1st Floor), online via paydici.com (vendor), or by mail (PO Box 27800, Albuquerque NM 87125-7800); monthly payment option exists
  • Without an assessor protest, a refund claim must be filed in District Court by the 60th day after the first installment due date, after paying the bill (cites 7-38-39 and 7-38-40 NMSA)

Tax rate

At $268,500, the median home value sits 35% above the New Mexico county median for this guide. The New Mexico county median income is $56,259, and Bernalillo County reports $66,514. Owner-occupancy is 64%, so renters hold about 36% of occupied homes. The median home was built in 1982, about 41 years ago.
